title: Thomas Wolfe House
scope: The preserved Old Kentucky Home on North Spruce Street, including its two-storey clapboard house, wraparound veranda, balcony and projecting bay.
limitations: Roof heights, rear window locations and the returns of the enclosed side porch are estimated from the photographs and mapped perimeter.
The model simplifies wood brackets, leaded glazing and veranda balusters. It depicts the standing restored building.
